meta.title: Athletes — NORVARDEN | Verified Jobs for Pro Athletes
meta.description: A free, verified job board for current and former pro athletes. Real jobs from verified companies. You control who can contact you.

hero.headline: Your next
hero.subheadline: The discipline, competitiveness and coachability that got you to the pros are exactly what great companies hire for.

items.title: A free, verified profile
items.body: Your athletic career, your credentials, your story — presented to companies that have already been reviewed by our team. No subscription, no fee, ever.

items.title: Jobs from verified companies only
items.body: Every company on NORVARDEN has had their work email, business name and hiring contact confirmed before they can post a single job. No scams, no ghost listings.

items.title: Help translating your career
items.body: Competed at the highest level? We help you put your athletic experience — leadership, pressure performance, team dynamics — into the language companies understand.

items.title: You control who can contact you
items.body: Companies send a connection request. Your phone number and email are never shared until you say yes. You stay in control of every conversation.

whoCanJoin.headline: Current and former
whoCanJoin.body: NORVARDEN is for current and former professional athletes — any sport, any league, any level of pro. Verification is quick: a link to a roster or league page, a players association ID, or a similar credential. No lengthy paperwork.
whoCanJoin.note: Everyone on NORVARDEN is verified before they can connect with companies.

industries.headline: Where athletes
industries.body: Your background opens doors across a wide range of industries. Here's where athletes on NORVARDEN are connecting.

neverPay.headline: Never pay
neverPay.body: Companies can never charge you for anything — not to apply, not to get hired, not for training, equipment or access. If anyone asks you for money, report it immediately.
